# Pulsus Risk

> Risk management software: one register for enterprise risks, audit and regulatory findings, key risk indicators and controls, read against your risk appetite.

This is the official website of Pulsus Risk: https://aboutrisk.pulsus.tech/
Pulsus Risk is part of the Pulsus Intelligence Suite (https://about.pulsus.tech/), made by Tumblehill Labs, a product studio of Tumblehill Holdings LLC. It works on its own.

## What it is

Pulsus Risk is risk register, audit findings and KRI software. It keeps one register for your enterprise risks, findings and key risk indicators. Risks are rated inherent, residual and target against your appetite. Findings from internal audit, external audit, regulators, compliance assessments and your own teams are followed to a validated close. Indicators are judged against their own target, tolerance and limit. A controls library links to the risks, and a committee pack comes out as PDF and Excel.

## Key features

- Overview: The whole position, at a glance
- Risk register: Inherent, residual and target
- Findings: Audit, regulator, compliance
- Key risk indicators: Target, tolerance and limit
- Risk appetite: From indicator to the board
- My work: Each person’s own inbox

## Price

- $750 a month, including 5 users; extra users are $75 each a month. For more than 50 users, talk to us.
- Prices in US dollars, as shown on the plans page: https://aboutrisk.pulsus.tech/plans/
- 14-day free trial, no card needed.
